authorization.basis: Explicit user permission in this task
authorization.question: Do you have permission to reuse the Timber Whales website photos on your site?
authorization.answer: Oh yes, I do. I'm part of that.
authorization.scope: The official TimberWhales website photographs, published roster portraits and club logos reused in this atlas project; no unrelated third-party or separate social-media imagery.
authorization.license: Permission for this project; no public or transferable copyright license claimed.
authorization.ownerIdentity: Not recorded. No inference about the user’s identity or any face in a photograph.
authorization.subsequentInstruction: After transfer, the task explicitly requested the 27 historical gallery stills, 12 published roster portraits, eight logo-based roster entries and two club logos.

transfer.method: Supported cloud browser downloadMedia, followed by the authorized repository transfer.
transfer.transportDetails: Public provenance includes only the published club page and public Wix image URLs; temporary download/storage URLs and tokens are not retained.

processing.sourceFiles: Downloaded Wix responsive renditions, not camera-original photographs. The research transfer files remain unchanged.
processing.display: The same downloaded bytes are served directly with decoder-verified JPEG/PNG extensions and MIME types. No recoding, cropping, reconstruction, enhancement or generated imagery. originalSrc links to this same downloaded rendition.
processing.deduplication: 41 distinct SHA-256 hashes; one local copy per unique source rendition. Shared roster logo and gallery hero reference existing files without duplicating bytes.
processing.visualReview: All 41 images viewed through local browser review sheets on 2026-10-02 before authoring descriptions.
